House.text: Introduction and first reading, referred to Legacy Finance

bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to arts and cultural heritage; appropriating money for a grant to Lao Culture Dance Fashion MN.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. [+APPROPRIATION; LAO CULTURE DANCE FASHION MN. +]

[+$160,000 in fiscal year 2027 is appropriated from the arts and cultural heritage fund to the commissioner of administration for a grant to Lao Culture Dance and Traditional Fashion Show LLC to foster traditional Lao dance and fashion arts education and public cultural programming for Minnesota youth and families. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to arts and cultural heritage; appropriating money for a grant to Lao Culture Dance Fashion MN.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. APPROPRIATION; LAO CULTURE DANCE FASHION MN.

$160,000 in fiscal year 2027 is appropriated from the arts and cultural heritage fund to the commissioner of administration for a grant to Lao Culture Dance and Traditional Fashion Show LLC to foster traditional Lao dance and fashion arts education and public cultural programming for Minnesota youth and families.
additions: APPROPRIATION; LAO CULTURE DANCE FASHION MN.
